title: Mixed Event — Hear Me! Hopeful Show♪ — Episode7 Only I Can Do It

meta.Episode: Episode7 — Only I Can Do It
meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! continue their livestreams, but Minori is plagued with unease as she fails to find acceptance from the group's fans. One day, an opportunity arises for a collaboration with a famous former idol turned streamer...

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's sing, dance and give our fans something they can really enjoy today too♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Minori, is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Luka...! Everyone!
I think I got it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That something only I can do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why... Please, I need you to teach me more about how to be an idol!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Minori...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
We can practice on the stage before today's show starts.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is that alright with you, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course♪ We can work on it together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you...!
I'll try my best!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Good, exaggerate each move so that everyone on the second deck can also clearly see what you're doing.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But while also focusing on what your fingers are doing as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No... I'm sorry!
I didn't do it right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's okay. Keep moving.
And don't forget to smile.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As long as you keep on smiling, everyone can keep having fun.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Right... Haruka said that we can't let doubt creep into their hearts.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (If I want them to smile, I have to as well...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Please, can we do that again?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're doing great, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's right! Rin and I were watching from where everyone sits, but you did just fine♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, would you mind giving me another lesson before our next stream...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, of course. Let's keep working on it until then.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We'll help too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much...!
song00004_off_f
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, that was awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're moving your body so much better now. You're also making fewer mistakes and have the more complicated parts nailed down.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I could sense that too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And you seem like you're having so much more fun now, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm guessing we'll make it just in time for our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. We only have just a little more to go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's keep trying but without pushing ourselves too hard.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! More! More! More!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great work today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: See you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Bye bye!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Minori. If you're free after this, would you like to walk home together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Lately, you've been busy and heading straight home after practice. I thought that it would be nice to do this for a change. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course! If it were up to me, I'd do this every single day...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's sweet.
Let's go.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our next livestream is right around the corner! I'm so nervous...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm also really happy about being able to perform on the same stage with everyone! I might finally feel like a real idol!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Minori. I keep telling you this but...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're already an idol and will always be one.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. That might be true, but I still haven't really done anything meaningful as an idol yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
On top of that, I ruined our last stream...
I have to do my best for everyone watching!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. You were already feeling down and I sort of just piled on top of that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What? Why are you apologizing, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was all my fault, so there's no reason for you to be apologizing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After that, I actually learned something. I found out that there's something that only I can do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I absolutely want our next livestream to go well...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You've changed a little, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You seem much more confident about being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really? You're making me blush...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was actually a little worried about you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It seemed like you were trying too hard after our last stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I want to keep trying. I want to catch up to you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to deliver hope to everyone with you, Haruka...! No, all of us! Together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I might end up making you worry again, but I also want you to believe in me too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? That's so me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. That's how you were able to help me out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you can do it. Let's go and deliver hope to everyone that comes to watch us...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you, Haruka...!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Minori, great work today!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much! I really appreciate all the help you've given me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really know what I'm doing now and it's all thanks to you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I think your drive to make your fans happy was what made this possible.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And as long as you don't forget that, I think your show will turn out great. I'm sure everyone watching will know it too.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You can do it, Minori!
We'll be trying our best too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Luka, Rin...
Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Our first show as MORE MORE JUMP!
It has to succeed!
